Private URIs using the g prefix are pointers to the respective lemmas in the FFDB collection of glossaries. Glossaries were taken from the original text source.

body.p: A reindeer and a mouse. A reindeer lived in some land. There lived a reindeer.[ShA:] There is no title in the audiorecording.This reindeer had a friend who was a mouse. Once the reindeer said: "My friend, let's play, I will hide and you seek for me."[ShA:] TÉkaradazÊ is an unexpected form, tÉkaradejÊ is normally expected. The reindeer hid. And the mouse sees someone's antler sticking out of the grass. Well. "I have found you, your antler is visible from the grass." The reindeer said: "Now you hide, and I will look for you. I will look for you." Well, then the reindeer.[ShA:] A false start. The mouse left and hid. The reindeer is looking, looking, looking, and says: "Where did he hide?". (â¦). He ate his friend with the ground. He ate his friend with the ground. Then. And the mouse made a hole in the belly of his friend. The reindeer died. The mouse called his friends and said: "Eat, eat, and I will sleep now, only leave me a bit." A mate said yes and left. The mouse got up, and there is no meat. The mates left. So the mates tricked the mouse. That's all.
